prompts.erlang: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art animation KEY POSE atlas for YANG JIAN / ERLANG SHEN as a playable Chinese mythology side-view action hero. Match reference game's crisp richly textured pixel clusters and limited aged gold, silver and deep teal palette, red cloth as small accent. Tall athletic male warrior with a clear THIRD EYE on forehead, dark hair topknot, white-silver scale armor, teal undercloth, pale cape, ornamental gold trim. Main weapon THREE-POINTED DOUBLE-EDGED POLEBLADE: long dark shaft, broad silver blade with three clearly separate forward points. Secondary an ornate curved hunting bow carried at back. Exactly 8 full body poses in 4 columns x 2 rows, all face screen-right. Same character, same body proportions, same scale, same costume and weapon construction. Equal roomy cells; floor anchors in each row align. Row1: idle weapon upright, running poleblade behind, airborne knees raised poleblade forward, short weapon thrust with both hands. Row2: broad poleblade slash follow-through, drawing hunting bow with arrow pointing right (poleblade stowed), raising hand to SUMMON HOUND (poleblade grounded), kneeling defeated leaning on poleblade. Each full silhouette and full weapon entirely inside its cell, NO crossing gutters. Transparent background, no scenery, no labels, no text, no UI, no watermark. Intended to normalize to approximately 75px tall character in game, strong readable silhouette not photorealism.
prompts.erlang_edit: Edit target: supplied Yang Jian pixel atlas. Preserve same hero identity, armor, colors, third eye and three-pointed poleblade exactly. RE-LAYOUT into EXACT 2 COLUMNS by 4 ROWS on a tall transparent canvas, providing much wider individual cells. This is a production sprite sheet. ALL weapons, capes and limbs MUST fit FULLY inside their own cell with AT LEAST 30px transparent gutters on every side. No overlap between poses, no stray pixels from another frame. SAME SCALE BODY across 8 frames, shared boot baseline per row. Each face RIGHT. Row1 idle poleblade upright / running poleblade behind. Row2 airborne knees raised / two-hand horizontal poleblade thrust (full tip fits inside cell). Row3 broad slash / draw hunting bow. Row4 summon hound hand raised / kneeling defeated. White-silver gold-trimmed armor, teal cloth, pale cape, third eye. Crisp pixel clusters, transparent true RGBA background. No labels/grid/text/scenery/UI.

prompts.cloud: Use case: stylized-concept. A production background plate for 2D side-scrolling Chinese mythology pixel-art action game, landscape 16:9. CLOUD REALM ABOVE THE WORLD: layered deep teal mountain peaks far below an immense sea of pale blue-white clouds, distant broken floating jade stairs and small ancient roofed pavilions, restrained old-gold details, long silk prayer banners drifting. Calm monumental sense of altitude, visible open sky; no modern elements. Rich crisp pixel clusters, limited palette matching reference game's blue-green/aged gold ruined temples. Wide panoramic composition, scene elements in middle and far background only. Keep lower third dark blue atmospheric clouds and visually quiet so gameplay platforms and enemies can be placed over it. No close foreground path/platform, no characters, no monsters, no text, no symbols, no UI. Background opaque, no transparency.

prompts.enemies: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PIXEL-ART ENEMY ATLAS for Chinese mythology 2D side-view platform action game. Exactly 2 columns x 5 rows, TEN separate full-body monster sprites, large transparent gutters, each fully inside cell, shared feet baseline, all facing LEFT. Consistent game style with detailed aged metal/cloth pixel clusters, strong silhouette, readable when 55-65px tall. Two different silhouettes per realm, no simple recolors. Row1 cloud: LEFT feather-helmet polearm celestial soldier, RIGHT floating winged wind shaman with feather fan. Row2 heaven: LEFT bulky red-gold armored guardian with rectangular jade shield, RIGHT stern thin thunder decree officer with scroll and lightning crown. Row3 underwater: LEFT armored shrimp soldier with long antennae and spear, RIGHT upright clam-shell demon holding pearl with split-shell silhouette. Enemies use muted dark purple/iron/red accents so friendly teal/gold heroes differ; preserve realm materials, NO huge glow or detached effects. No labels, no grid, no numbers, no text, no scene, no UI, no watermark. True RGBA transparent.
prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ART TERRAIN ATLAS for Chinese mythology 2D platform action game. Exactly 2 columns x 5 rows. Each row is ONE realm. Left cell: a single wide horizontal 2D walkable platform tile, clean perfectly horizontal top edge, decorated underside, fully visible with transparent gutter. Right cell: a square matching wall foundation texture, full square fill tile. Row1 CLOUD: pale blue jade slab with curled cloud carvings and small bronze clips, dark teal shadow. Row2 HEAVEN: ivory jade platform with vermilion/gold celestial frieze, dark red-grey pillar masonry. Row3 UNDERWATER: algae-dark sunken blue stone slab with seaweed small barnacles; deep blue rough stone foundation. Row4 DRAGON PALACE: jade-coral slab with scale carvings and pearl insets; dark turquoise scaled foundation. Row5 UNDERWORLD: charcoal slate with chain relief and dim jade insets; dark ink-stone foundation. Strong continuous light but muted walkable rim; old gold and detailed crisp pixel clusters consistent throughout. Platform art should be readable normalized to 64x30px, wall to64x64px. No scenery, no characters, no shadows outside tiles, no text, no labels, no grid, no watermark. Preserve transparent background around platforms, walls opaque inside own square.
